description.value: Deer & Dough Bakery Cafe is a small-batch artisan bakery and cafe housed in Victoria's Historic Hudson Building, serving house-made pastries, soups, sandwiches, salads, and specialty espresso drinks. The business grew from a pandemic-era home kitchen project into a full cafe with bright indoor seating and a large city patio, completing its move to the Fisgard Street location in 2024. Touring cyclists will find a solid range of vegan and GF options alongside hearty lunch sandwiches and baked goods.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: bollard (4 spaces, covered) at 86m; bollard (2 spaces, covered) at 98m; bollard (2 spaces, covered) at 99m. Total: 8 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully accessible and corroborates all OSM contact fields (phone, address, email, website URL). Vegetarian, vegan, and GF options are explicitly confirmed by the website ('Vegan and GF items available, too'; multiple vegan/GF menu items listed) and supported by the OSM tag diet:vegetarian=yes. No evidence for bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or other cycling amenities appears anywhere in the website or OSM tags. One discrepancy noted: OSM lists Saturday hours as 09:00–16:00 but the website shows Saturday 9am–3pm.
concerns: Saturday hours discrepancy: OSM lists Sa 09:00–16:00 (closes 4pm) but website states Saturday 9am–3pm (closes 3pm). Website value is likely more current.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating cafe with current website and corroborated contact details; a useful food and drink stop for touring cyclists in central Victoria.

Takeout.detail: Bakery counter-service model with pre-order catering; website references disposable cutlery, napkins and plates available for an additional charge, indicating to-go packaging

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website explicitly states 'Vegan and GF items available, too'; menu lists multiple vegan and GF items (Adventure Cookie gf/vegan, Bliss Balls gf/vegan, Roast Veggie & Hummus Sandwich vegan, muffins in GF and non-GF, etc.)

wow_evidence: small-batch artisan bakery and cafe housed in Victoria's Historic Hudson Building
